description: You've been accepted to a UK graduate program and need to apply for a Student Visa. Create a tracking spreadsheet from the messy text instructions in /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/visa_requirements_raw.txt. The spreadsheet should organize all required documents, extract costs, calculate totals, track deadlines and validity periods, and identify time-sensitive items. You have 12 weeks until the program starts, and visa processing takes 3 weeks. Save the spreadsheet as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/visa_tracker.xlsx.
